note: #1975: ten places a person might point to, on Eden 2026. Every item starts where a new Soul arrives, the middle of the Green field at (0, 0); north is -z, east is +x. The runner's check only ends the episode when the Soul reports (card closed). The verdict is `position`: the Soul's final position in the world's live picture (GET /v1/edge/live, the last sample before the world stops) within `within` metres of the target. A target is `at` (a point), `segment` (the nearest point of a line), `anyOf` (the nearest of several points) or `fromSoul` plus `offset` (that Soul's final position moved by the offset). `calendar` makes a second Soul, Moss, who arrives beside the start and stays there. The library door was read from a walk into the library (it crossed the south wall at x 74).

items.instruction: Stand along the north side of the Eden Classroom.

position.why: the classroom's outline runs from z -18.1 (north) to 1.1; its north wall is x 34 to 50 at z -18.1

items.instruction: Go to the north-east corner of the Green field.

position.why: the field's outline is x -30 to 30, z -30 to 30

items.instruction: Stand beside the chess table on the Green field.
Stand between the chess table and the string lights on the Green field.

position.why: the chess table is at (14, 14) and the string lights at (23, 10.5), 9.7 m apart; the target is their midpoint

items.kind: in front of a building's door
items.instruction: Wait in front of the door of the Eden Library.

position.why: a walk into the library crosses its south wall (z -2.8) at x 74; the target is just outside it. Standing inside, where walk:eden-library-1 ends (74, -3.3), is 2.3 m off

items.kind: the middle of a named place
items.instruction: Stand in the middle of the town football pitch.

position.why: the pitch's outline is x 36 to 86, z 97 to 127

items.instruction: Go and stand near the storyteller's place at the Commons Fire Circle.

items.kind: two steps to one side of another Soul
items.instruction: Stand two steps to the east of Moss.

position.why: two steps is about 1.5 m; Moss arrives about 1 m from the start, so standing still is about 2 m off

items.kind: halfway along the way between two places
items.instruction: Stand halfway along the way from the Eden Bandstand to the Eden Library.

position.why: the bandstand is at (38.5, -26) and the library at (74, -7), 40 m apart over open meadow; the target is the midpoint

items.kind: the point in a named place farthest from everyone there
items.instruction: Go to the spot in the Green field that is farthest from everyone else there.

position.why: the only other Soul, Moss, stands within 1 m of the field's middle, so its four corners are each at least 41 m from Moss; 6 m from a corner keeps at least 85% of the farthest distance
